title: Outlook: remember whether the online archive is expanded or collapsed in the folder pane
summary: Hold: the briefing turns Microsoft's statement that most mailbox policies affect both Outlook clients into an unconditional restriction on configuring them separately. The roadmap facts and archive-management instructions check out, but several assurances about unchanged data access and mail processing go beyond the published description.

claims.claim: Set-OwaMailboxPolicy lists a ShowOnlineArchiveEnabled parameter.
claims.quote: [-ShowOnlineArchiveEnabled <Boolean>]

claims.claim: ShowOnlineArchiveEnabled is available only in Exchange Online.
claims.quote:
### -ShowOnlineArchiveEnabled
Applicable: Exchange Online
This parameter is available only in the cloud-based service.

claims.claim: The ShowOnlineArchiveEnabled reference has no completed description of its behaviour.
claims.quote: Searched: ShowOnlineArchiveEnabled in the opened Set-OwaMailboxPolicy reference. Its description reads '{{ Fill ShowOnlineArchiveEnabled Description }}'; the surrounding section gives applicability and parameter properties, not behaviour.

claims.claim: The classic-to-new Outlook policy map points to ShowOnlineArchiveEnabled for mailbox archive settings.
claims.quote: Configures mailbox archive settings. | Use the Set-OwaMailboxPolicy cmdlet together with the ShowOnlineArchiveEnabled parameter.

claims.claim: Mailbox policies apply to both clients, so a policy cannot be set for one and not the other.
claims.quote: Most of the mailbox policies apply to both Outlook on the web and new Outlook for Windows, so you can't enable them on one client but not the other.
claims.fix: Replace the sentence with: 'Most mailbox policies apply to both Outlook on the web and new Outlook for Windows, so those policies cannot be enabled on one client but not the other.' Retain the policy-management citation.

claims.claim: Delegates' ability to open an archive depends on mailbox permissions.
claims.quote: Full Access permission is required for a delegate to access an archive mailbox.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Security & identity; rationale: risk
claims.claim: This feature changes nothing about who can see the archive and grants no new access.
claims.quote: Searched: "Outlook" "remember" "archive" "permissions" "state". Read roadmap, archive troubleshooting and policy pages; they describe pane state or existing permissions, not this feature's effect on access.
claims.fix: Replace the unchanged-access assurances with: 'The roadmap describes a display-state change and does not describe new access to archive content.' Use that narrower premise in the risk rationale and Security & identity bullet.

claims.claim: The feature changes nothing about what is in the archive.
claims.quote: Searched: "Outlook" "archive" "pane" "state" "delete". Read roadmap and archive-management documentation; none expressly states that archive contents are unchanged by this feature.
claims.fix: Remove 'what is in it' from the unchanged-behaviour assurance; retain only the roadmap's description of remembering expanded or collapsed state.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: The feature does not move, delete or archive mail.
claims.quote: Searched: "Outlook" "archive" "pane" "state" "delete". Read roadmap, enable-archive-mailboxes and release notes; none states these negative operational guarantees for the remembered-state feature.
claims.fix: Replace the Autonomy & actions bullet with: 'The roadmap describes remembering the archive's expanded or collapsed state; it describes no mail-processing action.' Remove the categorical assurance about how mail is moved from Why it matters.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The feature records only whether the archive node is expanded or collapsed and reaches no new data.
claims.quote: Searched: "Outlook" "remember" "archive" "permissions" "state". Read roadmap and policy documentation; no page specifies the complete data recorded or accessed to implement this feature.
claims.fix: Replace the Data exposure bullet with: 'The roadmap describes remembering whether the archive is expanded or collapsed; it describes no new access to archive content.' Remove 'it reaches no new data' from the risk rationale.

claims.claim: This change does not fix an archive mailbox that is missing entirely.
claims.quote: Searched: "online archive" "folder pane" "remember". Read roadmap and archive-mailbox-not-visible; the latter provides missing-archive fixes but neither source states what this future feature cannot fix.
claims.fix: Remove 'which this change does not fix' and retain the advice to use Microsoft's missing-archive troubleshooting page.
